title: Find the velocity function
text: Integrate the acceleration: $$v(t)=\frac{15}{\pi} sin\left(\pi t\right)+C$$. Since $$v(0)=50$$, $$C=50$$.

title: Plug in the time
text: $$40$$ minutes is $$\frac{2}{3}$$ of an hour. $$v\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)=50+\frac{15}{\pi} sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)=50+\frac{15\sqrt{3}}{2\pi}$$, which rounds to $$54.13$$ mph.
